title: 第1章 少尊第2章 你家住敦煌吗
slug: 狂仙出狱第2234章龙主燃尽
content_zh:
“美女，快点儿好吗？赶紧把裤子脱了，我们速战速决。”
位于龙国南荒地带的九幽监狱内，陈凡看着面前被丫鬟搀扶才能勉强站立的千金小姐，一脸猴急地说道。
眼前的千金小姐有着倾国倾城之姿，长发如瀑，朱唇皓齿，柳眉间带着几分英气，大有巾帼不让须眉之意。
“大胆！
你知道我家小姐是什么身份吗？再敢言语轻薄，信不信我割了你的舌头！”
丫鬟大声呵斥道。
“割了我的舌头？笑话！
这个世上能做到这点的，还没生出来呢！
而且你们最好想清楚，现在是你们有求于我，不想解毒，另寻他人好了！”
陈凡一甩手转身就走，结果被守在门口的监狱长洪军拦住了。
“少尊，您别生气啊，洛小姐身上的毒当世就只有你能解了，求你帮帮忙。”
洪军一脸恳求地说道。
监狱长低声下气向一个犯人求助，姿态卑微。
只因陈凡三年前因为故意伤人被关进九幽监狱后，认识了一位了不起的大人物。
老者自称仙道至尊，专门来九幽监狱待几个月，是为了在这里炼化一颗没人见过的‘九幽神石’。
犯人们都把老者当成神经病，不予理睬。
陈凡在被捕入狱后，老者见他资质绝佳，便将陈凡收为弟子，传授了一身能耐，医道神术，修仙之法，古今玄术……
从此以后，陈凡虽身在监狱之中，但却混得风生水起，把每个人治得服服帖帖！
师父为仙道至尊，监狱的人便尊称陈凡为‘少尊’。
“老洪，今天是我刑满释放的大好日子，我愿意多留一会儿帮你救个人就已经是给你面子了，既然她不肯配合，难道我还要求她？”

陈凡不悦道。
“我当然不是这个意思，少尊稍等，我去跟洛小姐说一下。”
言罢，洪军赶紧走到千金小姐身边，耳语了几句。
千金小姐经过一番深思熟虑，勉强点了点头。
“你们先出去，让我和陈神医单独待会儿。”
“是。”
洪军和丫鬟退出房间，千金小姐坐在床边疼得满头大汗，一句话都说不出来。
她的伤在臀部。
“别硬撑了，快趴下吧，按照老洪的描述，咬伤你的应该是一条有人精心培养的毒蛇，可能出自苗疆的五毒教。”
“如果不快点儿将那些毒素排出体外，轻则瘫痪，下半辈子在轮椅上度过，重则一命呜呼。”
“能找到我，是你的福气，别磨磨蹭蹭的了，赶紧按我说的办。”
就在陈凡说话之时，千金小姐体内的毒性已经再一次发作了，双手放在腰间却还有些迟疑。
“病不避医。”
陈凡一本正经地说道。
终于，千金小姐妥协了，将外裤脱下一截后，又将里面的蕾丝内裤也向下拉。
content_en:
"Beauty, hurry up, okay? Take off your pants quickly, let's fight quickly."
In the Jiuyou Prison located in the southern wasteland of the Dragon Kingdom, Chen Fan looked at Miss Qianjin in front of him who was barely able to stand with the help of a maid, and said with a look of urgency on his face.
The rich lady in front of her has the appearance of a charming woman, with long hair like a waterfall, red lips and white teeth, and a bit of heroism between her willow eyebrows, which makes her look like a woman who cannot be inferior to men.
"Bold!
Do you know who my young lady is? If you dare to speak frivolously again, believe it or not, I will cut out your tongue! "
The maid scolded loudly.
"Cut my tongue? What a joke!
No one in this world who can do this has been born yet!
And you'd better think clearly, now you are asking for help from me, if you don't want to detoxify, just find someone else! "
Chen Fan waved his hands and turned around to leave, but was stopped by the warden Hong Jun who was guarding the door.
"Young Master, don't be angry. Only you can cure Miss Luo's poison. Please help me."
Hong Jun said with a pleading look on his face.
The warden asked a prisoner for help in a humble manner.
Just because Chen Fan met a great man after he was imprisoned in Jiuyou Prison for intentionally hurting people three years ago.
The old man claimed to be the Supreme Immortal, and he came to Jiuyou Prison specifically to stay for a few months in order to refine a 'Jiuyou Divine Stone' that no one had ever seen before.
The prisoners all regarded the old man as a lunatic and ignored him.
After Chen Fan was arrested and imprisoned, the old man saw that he had excellent qualifications, so he accepted Chen Fan as his disciple and taught him his abilities, medical magic, immortality cultivation, ancient and modern mystical arts...
From then on, although Chen Fan was in prison, he prospered and managed everyone to be docile!
The master is the Supreme Immortal, so the people in the prison respectfully call Chen Fan 'Young Master'.
"Lao Hong, today is a great day when I am released from prison. If I am willing to stay a little longer to help you save someone, I am already giving you face. Since she refuses to cooperate, do I still ask her?"
Chen Fan said displeased.
"Of course I didn't mean it this way. Wait a moment, Young Master, I'll go talk to Miss Luo."
After saying this, Hong Jun quickly walked to Miss Qianjin and whispered a few words.
After some careful consideration, Miss Qianjin reluctantly nodded.
"You guys go out first and let Divine Doctor Chen and I be alone for a while."
"Yes."
Hong Jun and the maid left the room. Miss Qianjin sat on the bedside and was sweating profusely in pain, unable to say a word.
Her injury was on her hip.
"Stop holding on, get down quickly. According to Lao Hong's description, the snake that bit you should have been a poisonous snake carefully cultivated by someone. It may have come from the Five Poison Sect in Miao territory."
"If those toxins are not expelled from the body quickly, the patient may be paralyzed and spend the rest of his life in a wheelchair, or the patient may die."
"You are lucky to be able to find me. Stop dawdling and do as I say."
Just as Chen Fan was speaking, the toxicity in Miss Qianjin's body had already flared up again, and she still hesitated while placing her hands on her waist.
"Sickness should not be avoided."
Chen Fan said seriously.
Finally, the daughter-in-law gave in. After taking off her outer pants, she also pulled down the lace panties underneath.
